table.retrieve:
select  
	icode=code1,
	saleprice=Round(item.saleprice/ CASE WHEN Item.PackUnits > 0 THEN Item.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2),
	purprice=Round(item.purprice/ CASE WHEN Item.PackUnits > 0 THEN Item.PackUnits ELSE 1 END, 2),
	avgprice=item.avgprice,
	saleqty=isnull(value3,0),
	srqty=isnull(value4,0),
	purqty=isnull(value5,0),
	prqty=isnull(value6,0),
	netadjqty=isnull(value7,0),
	netissue=isnull(value8,0),
	active=CASE item.active WHEN 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,
	itemname=item.name,
	manufacturer=(select name from manufacturer where manufacturer.manfcode=item.manfcode),
	aliasname=item.customicode,
	category=(select name from itemCategory where icatcode=:ar_catcode),
	classname=itemclass.name,
	itemopeningstock= 
		(select isnull(sum(Case When purledger.purcatcode IN (3, 7, 8)  THEN
			purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.bonusqty
			Else (purdetail.packqty  + purdetail.bonusqty) * purdetail.packunits 
			END),0)
		from purdetail,purledger 
		where purledger.postdate < :ar_StartDate and 
				purledger.posted='Y' and
				purledger.purinvcode=purdetail.purinvcode and
				purdetail.icode=reportdata.code1) 
		-
		(select isnull(sum(saledetail.looseqty),0) from saledetail,saleledger 
		where saleledger.date < :ar_StartDate and 
				saleledger.saleinvcode=saledetail.saleinvcode and
				saledetail.due IS NULL and
				saledetail.icode=reportdata.code1)
		- 
		(select isnull(sum(duesatisfydetail.duesatisfyqty),0) from duesatisfyheader,duesatisfydetail
		where duesatisfyheader.duesatisfydate<:ar_Startdate and
			 duesatisfyheader.duesatisfycode=duesatisfydetail.duesatisfycode and
			 duesatisfydetail.icode=reportdata.code1)
		-								
		(select isnull(sum(issuedetail.qty),0) from issuedetail , issueheader
		where    issueheader.date < :ar_StartDate and 
				issueheader.issueinvcode=issuedetail.issueinvcode and 
				issuedetail.icode=reportdata.code1)
		+
		(select isnull(sum(receiptdetail.qty),0) from receiptdetail , receiptheader
		where    receiptheader.date < :ar_StartDate and 
			receiptheader.posted='Y' and
			receiptheader.receiptinvcode=receiptdetail.receiptinvcode and 
			receiptdetail.icode=reportdata.code1)
		+
		(select isnull(sum(srdetail.looseqty),0) from srdetail,srledger 
		 where srledger.date < :ar_StartDate and 
				srledger.srinvcode=srdetail.srinvcode and 
				srdetail.icode=reportdata.code1)
		+
		(select isnull(sum(Case when adjheader.adjcatcode=1 then
			 adjdetail.looseqty ELSE (-1) * adjdetail.looseqty END ),0)
		from adjdetail,adjheader 
		where adjheader.date <:ar_StartDate  and
			adjheader.adjcode=adjdetail.adjcode and
			adjdetail.icode=Reportdata.code1)
		-
		(select isnull(sum(prdetail.looseqty + prdetail.bonusqty),0)
		from prdetail,prledger 
		where prledger.date < :ar_StartDate and
			prledger.prinvcode=prdetail.prinvcode and
			prdetail.icode=reportdata.code1),
	currqty= ISNULL((select sum(currqty) from godowndetail where  icode = reportdata.code1),0)

from 
	reportdata, item LEFT OUTER JOIN itemclass ON (item.iccode=itemclass.iccode)
where 
	reportdata.code1=item.icode
order by 
	itemclass.name, item.name

objects.name: compute_32
objects.expression: sum(( itemopeningstock  +  purqty  +  srqty  -  prqty  -  saleqty  -  netissue  +  netadjqty  ) * saleprice  for all)

objects.name: compute_30
objects.expression: sum( saleprice * (  saleqty  -  srqty )  -  (purprice *  (  saleqty    -   srqty   )) for all)

objects.name: compute_12
objects.expression: sum( purprice  *  (  saleqty   -   srqty   ) for all)

objects.name: compute_11
objects.expression: sum( saleprice * (  saleqty  -  srqty )  for all)

objects.name: c_closingstkretailval
objects.expression: ( itemopeningstock  +  purqty  +  srqty  -  prqty  -  saleqty  -  netissue  +  netadjqty  ) * saleprice

objects.name: c_closingstk
objects.expression: itemopeningstock  +  purqty  +  srqty  -  prqty  -  saleqty  -  netissue  +  netadjqty

objects.name: c_netpruvalue
objects.expression: /* purprice  *  (  saleqty    -   srqty   )*/  avgprice *  (  saleqty    -   srqty   )

objects.name: compute_31
objects.expression: sum(( itemopeningstock  +  purqty  +  srqty  -  prqty  -  saleqty  -  netissue  +  netadjqty  ) * saleprice  for group 1)

objects.name: compute_29
objects.expression: sum( saleprice * (  saleqty  -  srqty )  -  (purprice *  (  saleqty    -   srqty   )) for group 1)

objects.name: compute_27
objects.expression: sum( saleprice * (  saleqty  -  srqty )  for group 1)
